text.p: These are the highlights of main stories in the Skopje press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The Macedonian government announced urgent imports of cement, meat and sugar and other articles due to price hikes and market shortages.
- The government discussed privatisation of FENIMAK with investments from Korea's Samsung and said the offer is open to other foreign investors.

- The EBRD will send a memorandum to Macedonia with terms under which it would enter the first round of privatisation of Macedonian telecommunications. This is a confirmation of the letter of intent signed in London ten days earlier by the Macedonian government and the EBRD.
- Long visa lines at the Greek border bring into question the publicised Greek openness towards the north. -- Mircela Casule, Skopje newsroom +389 91 201 196
